note: Both sets share the same core claims, including several duplicated pairs (joist/deck joist, frame/deck frame, reclaimed wood surface twice) and a couple of misbound dimension strings. Set A adds two flawed claims: a through-bolt diameter claim carrying an invented 'S-301' condition not present anywhere on the page, and a 'deck | plywood thickness | 3/4"' claim that misbinds the plywood-deck cross-section to the deck as a thickness and duplicates an existing claim. Set B instead adds a correct and useful through-bolt length (4") claim, so B is the more faithful set.
remarks: Shared issues in both sets: 'nut sleeve | dimension | 1"' merges two separate labels (1" NUT and SLEVE) and misbinds the nut size; 'decking footing plan | overall depth | 1'-0"' calls a plan dimension an overall depth; 'landscape footing | component width | 4 1/4"' has a vague attribute for a dimension that appears twice in detail A6. Both sets also omit notable page facts such as the 3/4" THREADED ROD, 1" NUT / SLEVE assembly in A6, 4X4 TO BE CUT AS NEEDED, and the 8'-0" and 7 1/2" dimensions. The text layer is a flat dump with no positional binding, so several dimension strings (1'-0", 4 1/4", 1 1/4", 3 3/4") cannot be reliably tied to a specific feature from text alone.
